name: Barber
ability: If you died today or tonight, the Demon may choose 2 players (not another Demon) to swap characters.
wakes: Never wakes itself; the night after the Barber dies, the Demon wakes to choose a swap, and swapped players wake to learn their new character.
interaction: Told: The Demon is shown 'This character selected you' and the Barber token; each swapped player is shown 'You are' and their new character. Chooses: The Demon may choose 2 players (not another Demon) to swap characters, or decline.
drunk_or_poisoned: If the Barber is drunk or poisoned when it dies, no swap happens (the Demon is not offered haircuts).

rulings.text: Alignments do not change when characters are swapped; each swapped player learns their new character.
The Demon may decline to swap.
A player who gains a character gains its full ability, including 'start knowing' and once-per-game abilities.
The Demon may swap itself, but may not swap with another Demon. If several Demons are alive, the Storyteller chooses which one swaps.
If a player dies and then becomes the Barber, the Demon cannot swap that night.

test_scenarios.name: Swap after execution
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Barber, Bob Snake Charmer, Carol Vortox, Dave Witch.
test_scenarios.actions: Alice is executed. That night Carol chooses Bob and Alice.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice becomes a dead good Snake Charmer and Bob a living good Barber; both are told their new characters.

test_scenarios.name: Demon swaps itself
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Barber, Carol Vortox (evil), Dave Witch (evil).
test_scenarios.actions: Alice is killed at night; the next night Carol chooses herself and Dave.
test_scenarios.expected: Carol is now an evil Witch and Dave the evil Vortox (the Demon).

test_scenarios.name: Demon declines
test_scenarios.actions: Alice is executed; that night Carol declines.
test_scenarios.expected: No characters change; Haircuts tonight is removed.

test_scenarios.name: Poisoned Barber
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Barber poisoned by Eve Poisoner, Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Carol is not offered a swap.

test_scenarios.name: Cannot pick another Demon
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Barber, Carol Imp, Dave Imp (second Demon), Bob Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Alice dies; Carol is woken to swap.
test_scenarios.expected: Legal choices exclude Dave; Carol may swap e.g. Bob with herself, but not with Dave.
